snippet.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
Coming 2026, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is the newest entry to the Hell Let Loose franchise. Here's an interview with developer Expression Games on what to expect from the the new title. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
